8.8. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.property¶

The modules defines functions to check the properties e.g. types and directions of railyard objects.

Functions

isArea(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Area.
isCrossing(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Crossing.
isDirection(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Direction.
isGenericInside(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type GenericInside.
isGenericOutside(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type GenericOutside.
isPath(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Path.
isPositive(obj, railyard[, globalOrientation]) Check if a railyard object is positively oriented.
isSignal(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Signal.
isSwitch(ryobj) Characteristic function for railyard objects of type Switch.
